title: OpenAI lends Cerebras $1B to build out capacity

sources.quote: Under the MRA with OpenAI, OpenAI has provided us with the $1.0 billion Working Capital Loan to accelerate the development and build out of services, technology, and manufacturing.

explain: As part of its compute deal, OpenAI lent Cerebras $1B (paid in January 2026) so Cerebras could build the systems OpenAI ordered. Cerebras repays it in installments after delivering the first 250 MW, by 2032 at the latest.
